SELECT archstat AS status, project_tally AS tally, 1.0 * project_tally / SUM(project_tally) OVER () AS share, 1.0 * project_tally / SUM(project_tally) OVER () - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
)
WHERE 1.0 * project_tally / SUM(project_tally) OVER () > 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()
